counterfactual.change: Removed the single detector_fail event (events [] instead of N detector_fail at 562). Restores visibility of empty N queue so actuated gap-out/max-green can end NS green.

explanation: Shrunk scenario has actuated=true with NS green held from step 491 through violation at 686 (>190s) while EW approaches wait >200s. Detector_fail on N (t=562, duration 164) blinds the only NS approach that always has queue 0 (arrival 0). The actuated controller therefore never sees own queue empty, so gap-out never triggers, and max_green_seconds / recall also fail to terminate NS green. Phase remains NS green at 578 (already >87s after 491) through 680-686, starving EW to wait 201. Removing detector_fail restores normal termination and eliminates violation.

violation.detail: approach 1 has waited 201 s at red with vehicles queued (limit 200)

vision_note: From steps 683 to 686 the intersection signal is frozen with green held for the north-south direction while the red-marked vehicles on the crossing approaches remain queued at red. The violating red bodies do not advance for multiple seconds as the perpendicular green persists, visibly starving the waiting direction.
